# Rasika.life

> Rasika.life is a community platform for Indian classical music and arts. It documents artists, compositions, ragas, talas, events, festivals, venues, and organisers — primarily focused on Carnatic and Hindustani classical traditions.

## What this site is

- A comprehensive reference for Indian classical music: artists, compositions (kritis), ragas, talas, languages
- A discovery platform for upcoming and past Carnatic and Hindustani concerts and festivals
- A community resource for rasikas (connoisseurs) of Indian classical arts

## Key sections

- [Artists](https://rasika.life/artists) — Profiles of Carnatic and Hindustani musicians, vocalists, and instrumentalists
- [Compositions](https://rasika.life/carnatic/compositions) — Kritis, varnams, and other compositions with raga, tala, and lyric information
- [Ragas](https://rasika.life/carnatic/ragas) — Raga reference with associated compositions and artists
- [Talas](https://rasika.life/carnatic/talas) — Tala reference with associated compositions
- [Events](https://rasika.life/events) — Upcoming and past Indian classical music concerts and performances
- [Festivals](https://rasika.life/festivals) — Music festivals and sabhas (e.g. Margazhi season events)
- [Venues](https://rasika.life/venues) — Concert halls and sabha venues
- [Organisers](https://rasika.life/organisers) — Sabhas, trusts, and organisations that present concerts

## What this site is NOT

- Not a streaming or audio/video platform
- Not affiliated with any government body or official music institution
- Not a ticketing platform (links to external ticketing where available)

## Contact

For corrections or contributions, visit https://rasika.life
